title: Enable ZATCA Phase Two in Zoho Books Saudi Arabia #Shorts
description:
Quick tutorial on activating Saudi ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing compliance natively inside Zoho Books settings.

1. Go to Zoho Books Settings and select 'Compliance' or 'E-Invoicing (ZATCA)'.
2. Enter your organization details, GSTIN/VAT number, and upload your ZATCA cryptographic stamp.
3. Test generation in the sandbox environment before switching the toggle to live generation.

- endpoint: Built-in Zoho Books Settings
